note: AIB's credit card rates (last reviewed 14 April 2025): its CLICK Visa Card's annual purchase interest rate is 9.11%, variable. AIB charges no annual bank fee, but applies the government's annual stamp duty of 30 euros on each credit card account, written as the card's yearly fee.
